reviews.name: Jules M.
reviews.body: The frosting is cream cheese, not that sugary whipped stuff. Took these to my sister's garden party and they were gone before the drinks came out.

reviews.name: Priya N.
reviews.body: My go-to. The crumb is genuinely velvet — soft without being wet, which is where most red velvet falls apart.

reviews.name: Dan R.
reviews.body: Great flavor, though a touch sweeter than I'd like. Pairs well with the lemon one if you're building a box.

reviews.name: Marcus T.
reviews.body: You can actually taste the browned butter — nutty and a little savory underneath. Most chocolate chip cookies are just sugar with chips in.

reviews.name: Elena K.
reviews.body: Still soft on day two, which almost never happens. The sea salt on top does a lot of work.

reviews.name: Chris B.
reviews.body: Solid and reliable. I wish the chocolate pools were a bit bigger but no real complaints.

reviews.name: Amara O.
reviews.body: Sharp, not artificial. It tastes like actual lemons rather than lemon flavoring, and the glaze cracks properly when you bite it.

reviews.name: Tom W.
reviews.body: The one I order after a heavy meal. Light enough that it doesn't sit on you.

reviews.name: Sofia L.
reviews.body: Bought a box for the office and this was the first to go. Even the people who 'don't like sweet things' had one.

reviews.name: Nina P.
reviews.body: Speculoos done properly — the caramel is burnt just enough to stop it being cloying. Dense in the good way.

reviews.name: Owen H.
reviews.body: Rich, so one is plenty. Very good with coffee, a bit much on its own.

reviews.name: Grace M.
reviews.body: My husband asks for this one specifically. The butterscotch actually tastes like butterscotch and not just brown sugar.

reviews.name: Jules M.
reviews.body: Ordered this for a birthday and it was the centerpiece. Real strawberries, and the cream isn't over-sweetened.

reviews.name: Ben A.
reviews.body: The shortcake layer holds up instead of going soggy, which is the whole problem with strawberry desserts.

reviews.name: Hana S.
reviews.body: Beautiful and it photographs well. Slightly messy to eat standing up at a party, so plan for plates.

reviews.name: Devon C.
reviews.body: Properly dark. The ganache center is still molten in the middle and it is not sweet, which is rare and welcome.

reviews.name: Rita J.
reviews.body: If you like dark chocolate this is the one. I pair it with the lemon to cut through.

reviews.name: Alex F.
reviews.body: Very rich — I split one. Cocoa nibs on top add a nice bitter crunch.

reviews.name: Yuki T.
reviews.body: Actual ceremonial-grade matcha flavor, grassy rather than sweet. Plant-based and you genuinely cannot tell.

reviews.name: Marco D.
reviews.body: Coconut is subtle, which I liked. If you want a strong coconut hit this isn't it, but the balance is good.

reviews.name: Leah B.
reviews.body: Dairy-free and it doesn't taste like a compromise. My daughter can't have dairy and she picks this every time.

reviews.name: Isabel R.
reviews.body: Fig and almond is an underrated pairing and this nails it. Barely sweet, more like something you'd get after dinner.

reviews.name: Paul G.
reviews.body: The frangipane is proper — dense, nutty, not the gluey kind. Worth the extra dollar.

reviews.name: Mira K.
reviews.body: Lovely but it does contain almonds, obviously, so not one for a mixed group with nut allergies.

eventMenus.name: Harvest Festival
eventMenus.blurb: Brown sugar, spiced pear and maple pecan, built for cool evenings.

reviews.name: Kara W.
reviews.body: Real maple, not syrup flavoring, and the pecans stay crisp.

reviews.name: Joel M.
reviews.body: Sweet but the pecan bitterness balances it. Very autumn.

reviews.name: Tess H.
reviews.body: The pastry shatters properly and the pear isn't mushy.

reviews.name: Raj P.
reviews.body: Spicing is restrained — you can still taste the fruit.

reviews.name: Molly F.
reviews.body: Tastes like the ones from an orchard. The cinnamon sugar is generous.

reviews.name: Evan S.
reviews.body: Best eaten same day. Still good the next morning but not the same.

eventMenus.name: Holiday Table
eventMenus.blurb: Gift towers and dessert tables sized for a full house.

reviews.name: Dana L.
reviews.body: Snaps cleanly and the peppermint is cooling rather than toothpasty.

reviews.name: Nate K.
reviews.body: Very sweet. Good in small pieces with coffee.

reviews.name: Clara V.
reviews.body: Showstopper for the table. The ganache is dark enough to offset the sponge.

reviews.name: Sam O.
reviews.body: Ordered for twelve people and it sliced beautifully.

reviews.name: Hugo B.
reviews.body: Proper molasses depth and a real ginger burn at the end.

reviews.name: Anita D.
reviews.body: Warming and not too sweet. I'd like a touch more spice.

eventMenus.name: Lunar New Year
eventMenus.blurb: Red bean, sesame and citrus in a share-first gift format.

reviews.name: Wei L.
reviews.body: The lotus paste is smooth and not grainy, which is the giveaway for a good one.

reviews.name: Fiona C.
reviews.body: Gave these as gifts and they were very well received.

reviews.name: Jin H.
reviews.body: Chewy outside, warm sesame inside. Exactly right.

reviews.name: Nora A.
reviews.body: Lovely texture. Best eaten fresh rather than saved.

reviews.name: Ravi S.
reviews.body: Short, crumbly and toasty. Reminds me of the bakery ones growing up.

reviews.name: Gina T.
reviews.body: Simple and good. Not flashy, just well made.

eventMenus.name: Graduation Season
eventMenus.blurb: Colorway-matched boxes for school colors and big group orders.

reviews.name: Beth N.
reviews.body: The confetti doesn't bleed into the crumb, so it still looks sharp when sliced.

reviews.name: Omar Y.
reviews.body: Ordered for a graduation and it did the job — fun without being childish.

reviews.name: Lucy P.
reviews.body: Adorable and the cocoa is actually dark, so adults ate them too.

reviews.name: Theo R.
reviews.body: Cute. The gold dust does transfer onto fingers a bit.

reviews.name: Ada M.
reviews.body: Proper curd, properly sharp. The shortbread base doesn't go soft.

reviews.name: Kyle J.
reviews.body: My favorite of the spring menu. I order two.

reviews.name: Jules M.
reviews.body: The concierge picked the Strawberry Shortcake for my sister's garden party and it was the centerpiece. Gone in minutes.

reviews.name: Ari K.
reviews.body: Bright, buttery, not too sweet. The Lemon Glaze Cloud is my new personality.

reviews.name: Riley S.
reviews.body: Ordered by voice on the drive home and it was boxed and waiting. Genuinely felt like magic.

reviews.name: Dev P.
reviews.body: Great plant-based options, which is rare. Would love one more nut-free pick in the rotation.
